about_short_description.short_description: Dittofeed provides an open-source customer engagement platform for businesses.

product.name: Omni-channel Messaging Automation
product.description: A platform for automating marketing and transactional messages across multiple channels including email, SMS, and webhooks.

product.name: User Segmentation Engine
product.description: A low-code engine to create customizable user segments based on traits, actions, and subscription status for targeted messaging.

product.name: Low-code Drag-and-Drop Journey Editor
product.description: A visual editor for designing automated messaging workflows triggered by user actions or segment membership.

product.name: Email and SMS Template Editor
product.description: A low-code editor for creating personalized email and SMS message templates using user properties and Liquid syntax.

product.name: Webhook Messaging Channel
product.description: A channel to send automated API requests to external services for messaging beyond email and SMS.

product.name: Embedded Components and White-labeling
product.description: Self-hostable components and dashboards that can be embedded and branded within other SaaS applications.
